name: Arthur
source:
Arthur is Nigel’s other co-worker. He is an energetic, enthusiastic and excitable person. He thinks, speaks, acts and reacts quickly. But because he's wrapped just a little too tight, sometimes his excitement can overwhelm him--making him the character most likely to panic. He is more nervous and apprehensive than his co-workers. Arthur may not be the most easy-going of the friends, but he's probably the most enthusiastic.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31420]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
